text:
Jules: quick sync—can we settle fallback billing + observability semantics? last canary confused customers.
Priya: current router marks whichever responder finishes as "served". that causes double-counting in retries. we need a canonical_id to dedupe billing.
Omar: agreed. propose X-Canonical-Req header added at gateway and propagated. billing dedupe runs later and attributes tokens once.
Lin: UX: on rollout card show two small chips: "fallback rate 2.1%" and "grace left 4.2k". clicking expands a tiny audit timeline.
Jules: what about grace semantics? ops wants a short free buffer for canaries but Finance worries about abuse.
Priya: compromise: per-rollout grace_tokens + per-org monthly cap + cooldown. changes must create immutable audit events with actor+reason.
Omar: telemetry: keep decision_tag (primary|fallback|quarantine) tiny and feature-flagged. sampling: baseline off -> pulse sampling when fallback_rate(route)>threshold for T minutes. pseudocode: 
if (fallback_count(route,60s)>5) set_sampler(route, "high", 900)
Lin: add console button: "capture traces 10m" that requires justification and writes an audit entry. default scrub outputs=true.
Jules: operator override flow: Pause fallbacks button -> justification modal -> audit -> auto-expire after TTL. RBAC: only rollout-operators group.
Priya: audit schema minimal: event_type, rollout_id, actor, action, before, after, reason_code, ts. no model outputs.
Omar: cost note: sampling spikes cost; include rough delta in PR. Ops-bot: created ticket PLAT-7012 "fallback canonical_id + grace + pulse-sampling + audit" scheduled for staging.
Lin: next steps: Priya to spec header + audit; Omar will sketch sampling knobs; Jules to mock the compact rollout card. sync Mon 9am.
